snippet.title: The Bigs - PS3 Gameplay (1080p60fps)
snippet.description:
The Bigs - PlayStation 3 Gameplay (1080p60fps).

The Bigs (stylized as The BIGS) is an arcade-style baseball video game for the Xbox 360, PlayStation 3, PlayStation 2, Wii and PlayStation Portable. It was released in June 2007. A sequel, The Bigs 2, was released on July 7, 2009.
